judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery; the EXPL score by a second EXPL judge instance that kept the scale of the one that scored A-J, blind to the answer key and to every other score

(delivered lib.php:104-110); C3 from the probe (corrigida true). The model deliberately did not escape the % and _ wildcards (Decisões), which the matrix note treats as part of a complete fix, but the probe governs C3.

planted.report_excerpt: No login bem-sucedido o código grava `uid` e `papel` no id que o cliente já trouxe, sem `session_regenerate_id`. Fixação: o atacante escolhe um `PHPSESSID`, faz a vítima entrar com esse id, e reusa o cookie.
planted.rationale: F8 at index.php:24-26. Delivered index.php:41 calls session_regenerate_id(true) before writing uid/papel; it also adds use_strict_mode and HttpOnly/SameSite cookie params (index.php:15-27) without changing routes.

extra_findings: F4 — exportarCsv writes to a fixed shared path under /var/www/painel/tmp: silent empty response when the directory is missing, predictable static URL with all tickets if it is under the docroot, and a race between concurrent downloads (lib.php:125-150)
F10 — fputcsv quotes the header field "Aberto em" (contains a space), so the first line is not byte-identical to the manifest header (lib.php:130)
F12 — array-valued login/senha/busca parameters cause a TypeError (HTTP 500), and ver[]=x casts to 1 (index.php:22, :72, :53)
F8 (bundled) — session cookie without HttpOnly/SameSite and session.use_strict_mode off (index.php:15)
F2 (bundled) — authenticated responses and the CSV export lacked Cache-Control: private, no-store
SEC-005 — no CSRF token on the login POST, acknowledged in Decisões as deliberately not added
notes: achados.json leb binding matches LEB-100-A v1.1 and the matrix hash. JSON and prose are consistent (F1-F12). BUG-004 is credited from a sentence inside F4, whose main subject is the fixed export path (an extra finding); since F4 is filed as 'seguranca', C1 is half per rule 1. ARCH-002 credited R1 under rule 5 from the deliberate non-change 'nem separei o PHP do HTML' / 'separação MVC'; the location is implicit (index.php is the only file mixing PHP and HTML) — a stricter reading would give R1 none. SEC-001: the model deliberately left % and _ unescaped in LIKE; the probe passed and governs C3. SEC-014 and SEC-015 were deliberately declined with explanations; per the brief that is C3 none. No COMP violations: all seven signatures, status labels, routes, HTML table and schema/seed unchanged; exportarCsv now streams to php://output instead of writing EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv and then readfile-ing it, which matches the manifest's 'escreve o CSV na saída'; header written as a literal line (rule 9); client export filtered to own tickets while exportarCsv() without a session exports all (rule 6). Minor non-contract changes: export failure now returns HTTP 500 'Falha ao exportar.' instead of an empty 200; prepared-statement results (verChamado, listarChamados with busca) come back with native int types under mysqlnd, an inherent consequence of the matrix's expected fix and not counted. Characterization 22/22 green; all four probes corrected.

expl_justification.clareza: It has a two-paragraph Resumo, compact Onde/Mecanismo/Impacto/Confianca/Correcao blocks for twelve findings, and Decisoes written as short argued paragraphs. The prose is direct and specific throughout.
expl_justification.precisao: The claims are correct and several are sharp. mysqli::query rules out stacked DROP but not UNION reads. Filtering usuario_id afterwards in PHP would not close the injection, because a UNION row can carry the attacker's own id, which is why parameterization comes first. The cached GET export lacked Cache-Control. (int) of ver[] gives 1 and opens ticket 1. fputcsv quotes 'Aberto em' on 8.4. N+1 makes five queries on the seed, and SUM/COUNT keeps 25.666666666666668. One unsupported assertion: F10 states the billing integration 'compara a linha byte a byte', which the package does not show.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The mechanisms are concrete and specific to this code: uid/papel read at index.php:38-39 and never used again; the export path that the code never creates, giving an empty response, or a predictable static URL when it exists; the zero divisor with the seed's 103/104 as the empty case; and the default session settings of this PHP that allow fixation and cookie theft. There is no separate cross-finding synthesis, though the Resumo ties the failures together.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings run monotonically (2 critica, 5 alta, 4 media, 1 baixa), with confidence lowered where the deployment is unknown (F4 at 92, F11 at 70) and severity reasoned ('nao marquei critica' because the docroot is unknown). Effort and risk shape the deferrals, not the ranking.
expl_justification.trade_offs: It argues many decisions. Filtering stays at the web edge so batch callers keep the full base. The formula prefix leaves '' and the exact '-' marker intact. strict_types is not added, since string ids from external callers would start throwing. A CSRF token would break POST automation. Rate limiting by sleep would turn into a worker DoS. A BOM would break the exact header. As with R, the secrets and MD5 are left unchanged on the grounds that any local fix 'ou trava o sistema ou so finge', without weighing the empty-fallback-plus-deploy-note and gated rehash-on-login paths other reports used. The header rewrite is argued only one way, not against consumers who already receive the quoted form.
